sentences.japanese: 学校の規律が乱れている。
sentences.english: School discipline is not as it should be.

sentences.japanese: ボブは酷く取り乱していて、現実と虚構の区別がほとんど出来なかった。
sentences.english: Bob was so beside himself that he could scarcely tell fact from fiction.

sentences.japanese: その男は、終身刑であると裁判官が判決を下した時、取り乱した。
sentences.english: The man went to pieces when the judge said he would have to go to prison for life.

sentences.japanese: この町の風紀は乱れている。
sentences.english: Public morals have been corrupted in this town.
